kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
ننهزل (form VII)
# نَنْهَزِلُ (nanhazilu) /nan.ha.zi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# نَنْهَزِلَ (nanhazila) /nan.ha.zi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
# نَنْهَزِلْ (nanhazil) /nan.ha.zil/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْهَزَلَ (inhazala)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
